contract_question: tick633 (fork-2, genuinely-DISTINCT non-deterministic probe): does random-data/measure-valued probabilistic-smoothing (Burq-Tzvetkov/Nahmod-type a.s. global regularity for randomized supercritical NS data) constitute a genuinely-new MECHANISM transportable to the DETERMINISTIC critical a-priori (Clay, ∀-data), or is a.s.≠∀ the honest structural wall — the probabilistic gain (independence/Wiener-chaos cancellation in the random Fourier series) being by construction UNAVAILABLE for the worst-case deterministic datum (which lies in the measure-zero complement the method discards)?
rationale_short: both core claims yes: random-data genuinely distinct (probabilistic independence/cancellation, not relabel) AND non-transportable to Clay ∀ (a.s. off measure-zero set for a chosen law; worst-case data where theorem is silent). caveat: 'precisely the blowup set' too strong — exceptional set merely MAY contain bad data
